about_the_game:
WinMon is a cozy–yet–chaotic idle and farming hybrid game where you raise, feed, and command adorable tiny monster creatures known as WinMons to join capitalism. Whether you’re grinding through study sessions or surviving long workdays, your WinMons are always by your side on your desktop screen—cute, curious, and just a little too eager to bite into some Cybugs. But most importantly, they are just like you, living as corporate slaves, extracting their own life essence to produce items. Welcome to their tiny playground, where life is as much about eat, work and sleep.


Idle Meets Farming

Your WinMons will take a stroll around, hunt Cybugs when hungry, and work on machines—or themselves—even when you’re away. But to keep them efficient and cheerful, you’ll need to manage their hunger and rest. Each action they take shapes how your tiny ecosystem thrives—or collapses into bankruptcy.

Hunger & Happiness System

WinMons get hungry over time. Let them hunt Cybugs to stay healthy and active. A full belly means better performance and happier moods—ignore their needs for too long, and they might refuse to work… leading to the worst consequence of them all, no money!

Profession System

Every WinMon can learn a Profession that defines their role in the playground—like Seeders who sow seeds, Waterers who water and Lighter who support photosynthesize. Some machines only run when the right WinMons with the right Jobs are assigned to them, so plan your team carefully. Train, specialize, and balance your crew to build the most efficient tiny automatic farm possible.

Machine, Plantation & Facility Management

Build and upgrade interactive buildings that automate your playground—from Plantation and Magic Tree to Energy Factory to generate electricity. Each building changes how your WinMons live and work, but they won’t run themselves—your team’s Jobs are the key to keeping the gears turning.

Glorious volution Through Production

As your WinMons work and produce items, they’ll consume the items they make to evolve into stronger, rarer forms with higher working capability, slowly turning your army into a fashion show of cool WinMons.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Dual Core 2 GHz
  • Graphics: Graphic Card with VRAM 2 GB or higher
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Feed your cute little monsters right on your desktop! And once full, it's time to work! From sowing seeds, watering plants, providing light to mining ores and chopping trees. Resources don't come on their own and food isn't bought with air. Everyone will need to work.

English*, Vietnamese*, Russian*, Simplified Chinese*, Japanese*
*languages with full audio support
